parent_objective: audit M1362 selected alpha before any broader replay or promotion route
blocked_by: M1362 found a passing alpha but only on exact metrics plus two public replay preflight surfaces

public_gates: M1363 must not update actor weights
M1363 must not use private holdout
M1363 must decide the next gate for alpha 0.1 without overclaiming

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether M1362 alpha 0.1 is strong enough to route to a broader public replay gate
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, actor-update, replay, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if the audit treats M1362 alpha 0.1 as promoted
stop if the audit ignores that only two public replay surfaces passed
stop if the audit routes directly to private holdout
stop if the audit routes directly to PPO
fallback_plan: if alpha 0.1 is judged useful, route to a scoped broader public replay design
if alpha 0.1 is judged too weak, route to gap-aware active-set design
if the result is ambiguous, route to repeat interpolation or row-level audit
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1362 produced a passing selected alpha after a positive bidirectional active-set probe direction

admission_evidence: M1362 alpha 0.1 passes exact metrics plus M267/M264 and M183/M170 replay preflights
M1362 alpha 0.1 is stronger than M1352 alpha 0.005 but not full public replay
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: audit chooses the next public gate

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1363 audits public proof preflight and cannot claim anticipatory self-identification.
history_necessity_tests: audit must preserve the distinction between replay preflight and stronger self-ID evidence
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1362 exact and two-surface replay preflight artifacts.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If alpha 0.1 is insufficient, route to additional public proof gates before any private holdout or promotion.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: M1362 alpha 0.1 is a useful replay-preflight candidate but needs an audit before broader public replay or any promotion route.
success_criteria: audit records M1362 selected alpha and exact metrics
audit records M1362 M267/M264 and M183/M170 outcomes
audit states that M1362 is not promotion
audit routes to a specific next public gate
no training, PPO, replay, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: audit omits selected alpha or replay results
audit routes directly to private holdout or PPO
training, PPO, replay, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1363 passes as an audit only if it routes M1362 alpha 0.1 without training, replay, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input changes.
